data.narrative:
Notus Autonomous Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Emmanuel Margolin and Arhum Jain, having raised $500K to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies in the same sector and stage band, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $500K total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The two methods produce materially divergent signals. Stage-progression supports a low valuation near $1M, while peer-median anchors to $1.0B, reflecting the substantial capital and valuations commanded by defense autonomous systems companies at comparable maturity. The triangulated range is $1M to $1.1B, with a median of $501M. Key uncertainties include differentiation versus the five-peer sample, technology validation progress post-seed, and customer traction in a capital-intensive defense procurement environment.
